programmes.t: Ted Nugent Spirit Of The Wild
programmes.d: Ted takes a nice buck at SpiritWild Ranch with his Mathews bow. Plus, watch the television debut of What would Charlie Daniels do?, the new song from Ira Dean featuring Ted Nugent. This is an episode you don't want to miss!

The Slock Master reveals the tricks and tips that fool predators. Bowhunting coyotes, fox, lion, bobcat and more with incredible close-up call-ins and amazing archery action. Watch the world's top bow hunter slock em on The Slock Master.

What happens to the elephants when an area reaches carrying capacity? Dan Cabela investigates the growing problem, visiting Zimbabwe, Namibia and Angola to explore the future of elephant conservation.
Kansas rut action heats up as Cadyn Wall steps into the spotlight with a hunt the family won't forget back at deer camp.
Brody hunts his home state of Pennsylvania for Upland bird and Turkey.

programmes.t: Argo's How To Hunt with Ryan Kohler
programmes.d: Ryan Kohler and Gunther Tondelier head deep into Alberta's timber in search of elk. After days of hard hunting, the duo finishes strong with full freezers.
Brad kicks off the episode by explaining how doe management has helped improve the deer herd on his property before we join Noah's former coworker Brent and his son for a successful doe harvest.

Steve Bartylla reveals how to transform your hunting property into an absolute whitetail magnet by identifying & supplying what local deer lack most. Take a deep dive into the science of antler development as Steve breaks down genetic caps.
This week on Shoot Straight TV it is elk hunting time in Montana with the CVA Cascade's. Marsha has a delicious recipe from the field and Chad will give a Straight Talk Tip of the Week.

This week, we're having fun in the sun with our friends from Garmin as we travel to Grand Isle, Louisiana, to debut the latest and greatest Garmin gear, and go to battle with some of the strongest, savviest fish in the sea!
We head back to the Mecca of Jumbo Perch at Lake Cascade, ID!
Join us this week as Shawn and crew travel to West Texas for some fabulous Crane & Pheasant hunting !
This week we are looking back at our favorite Indiana hunts from over the years!
Kip and the kids have an epic dove hunt, and Kat takes her biggest buck with a bow on opening day. Meanwhile, across the mountain, their producer, Ryan, is chasing some great bucks with his bow.
Wilbur and team are headed back for another adventure at Dos Hermanos for part 1.
We're back in the field with TenPoint Crossbows, the leader in crossbow technology, as we're on the quest for learning more about their latest and greatest, harvesting some Texas whitetail, and more.
Daniel Schmidt and Zach Haas dive into the topic of Epizootic Hemorrhagic Disease (EHD), exploring what it is, how it spreads, and the impact it has on whitetail deer populations.

The best whitetail deer hunting stories from across the nation; incorporating product features, up-close encounters, storytelling, insight about management, as well as tactics to both entertain and educate even the most seasoned whitetail hunter.
We're back in South Texas for another action-packed episode. This week Max and the crew are hunting hard for whitetail bucks and javelina.
Just because you have the greatest invention in fishing doesn't always guarantee success. G3 Sportsman Scott Turnage and Westin Yancey throw everything but the kitchen sink at the crappie.

Brett takes Heli-Hunter pilot Cody out for his first thermal hog hunt to see if he's as good on the ground as he is in the air. Then Charles, Brett and the Three Curl crew head to a dove-loaded water hole for an afternoon of fast shooting.
Viejo Creek Outdoors goes international! Keith takes a trip to Cabo to hunt big Marlin with Captain Alex Rogers.

In this episode, Rock and the OTR crew take Rascal Flatts lead singer Gary LeVox out on the water for an epic day of bow fishing before his big concert! They share plenty of laughs and Cajun hospitality.
Aspiring trappers head to Kansas for an intensive hands-on education at a premier trapping school. Students learn essential techniques from Alan and Stu Miller.
The final episode in this three-part Wyoming trapping classic follows Chappy as he continues thinning out coyotes to help the rancher achieve better calving success come spring.

Mark Peterson ventures into the heart of Germany's forests in pursuit of a Black Roe Deer, one of Europe's most coveted trophies. Known for their striking dark coat and exceptional wariness, these animals present a unique challenge even for...

Superstar influencer Lex the Electrician visits the garage to show us how her mobile workspace helps her get the job done, learn how electronic ears can pinpoint little problems before they become big problems, and more.
Some RVers avoid Mexico due to concerns about safety or complicated border procedures, but touring in a group makes the beauty and adventure of Mexico possible with ease.
Patrice and Kevin McCabe show off outtakes and extra footage, including the new Winnebago unveiling and bonus footage from Branson, Missouri.

The day kicks off with a one-of-a-kind hatting ceremony as Don Mann is crowned-then quite literally set on fire. But there's no time to admire the flames; Ken Shamrock is waiting with another round of punishing Lion's Den training.

programmes.t: The High Road With Keith Warren
programmes.d: On this episode of The High Road with Keith Warren, Keith gets back into archery as he hunts with his bow in search of a monster Legends Ranch buck! Legends Ranch in Bitely, Michigan is known for having the biggest whitetail deer in North America...
After two years with the Canadian border closed due to the pandemic, host Gus finally makes it back to Alberta Bush Adventures in the Peace River boreal forest - but not without a fight.

Kenny faces one of his biggest challenges yet as he navigates Colorado's unforgiving mountain terrain on the final day of his elk hunt. With two consecutive archery elk tags already filled, he's determined to make it happen for a third success.
When it gets cold out it's time to move to the basins!

Duane Inglin and Bill Herzog Back In-Studio to discuss extreme low river conditions and proven techniques to find success on Chinook and Coho. Join the guys in The Bait Lab for step-by-step rigging tips.

Allan and Denise Rovig of McWhorter Custom Rifles travel to Illinois to hunt the first firearm season with their McWhorter 45 XML muzzleloaders.

In this episode follow along as Nate, Rob, and Josh and trying to punch some archery tags on nice bucks in Michigan. Nate takes a big gamble to try and catch a dandy buck on his way to food and it paid off!

On this episode, the guys head to Oklahoma to hunt with their good friend Kenny Covington. Oklahoma is a special place they look forward to hunting every year. It's a fun trip filled with good friends, great memories, and time in the woods.
